name: DOOM for iOS (unofficial)
subtitle: DOOM, DOOM II and Final DOOM on iPhone and iPad
description:
An unofficial fan port of UZDoom to iPhone and iPad, with touch controls: one app, DOOM, for The Ultimate DOOM, DOOM II, Final DOOM and their add-ons.

You need your own copy of DOOM. No game files are included.

It's a beta. Guide and bug reports: https://github.com/sithewok13-dev/UZDoom/tree/ios

Not affiliated with or endorsed by id Software, Bethesda, Nightdive Studios or the UZDoom team.

apps.name: DOOM
apps.subtitle: DOOM, DOOM II and Final DOOM, with touch controls
apps.localizedDescription:
An unofficial fan port of UZDoom, the open-source DOOM engine that carries on ZDoom and GZDoom, to iPhone and iPad. Play The Ultimate DOOM, DOOM II, Final DOOM (TNT: Evilution and The Plutonia Experiment) and the add-ons SIGIL, SIGIL II, No Rest for the Living, The Master Levels and Legacy of Rust.

- Touch controls made for DOOM: a move stick where your thumb lands, drag to look
- A weapon wheel with the game's own pictures and ammo
- Six HUD looks, from DOOM's classic status bar to small modern pills
- A camera: photos, bursts, selfies with the monsters, and Action Freeze
- The sithewok cheat with a cheat menu (Noclip, Full map, Berserk...), LEVEL select, tilt aiming, 60 or 120 fps
- LAN co-op and deathmatch (new and barely tested)

You need your own copy of DOOM (the DOOM + DOOM II re-release on Steam or GOG has every game); no game files are included. Open the app once, then copy your .wad files into Files > On My iPhone > DOOM.

It's a beta: expect bugs, and back up your saves. LAN multiplayer has never been tried between two phones and may not work.

Bug reports and the full guide: https://github.com/sithewok13-dev/UZDoom/tree/ios

Not affiliated with or endorsed by id Software, Bethesda, Nightdive Studios or the UZDoom team.
